records.english: Claudio said it:{LB@24}Let's go to sea!{LB@41}Julio might lend us{LB@65}the money!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor

records.english: Right now,{LB@10}we're going to see Julio!{LB@37}Let's go!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor

records.english: Janus, work with Claudio!{LB@28}We're counting on you!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor

records.english: {HEX:05}Good grief...{LB@14}He is the most{LB@30}excited of us.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus

records.english: {HEX:04}Ha! Claudio rubbed off on him.{LB@37}Once decided, nothing stops him.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus

records.english: {HEX:05}That's how he has always been.{LB@31}He rarely shows it, though.{LB@60}How are the repairs?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus

records.english: {HEX:05}Quit fussing over details.{LB@37}You enjoyed every second.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus

records.english: {HEX:04}That's true.{LB@27}Shall we head over too?{LB@54}To Julio's place.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus

records.english: {HEX:05}Yeah.{LB@7}Someone must watch over him.{LB@36}FI above all.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus

records.english: {HEX:06}What?! Another advance?{LB@33}Claudio, you scoundrel!{LB@68}What will you spend it on?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio

records.english: {HEX:05}This time is different!{LB@33}We'll take this seriously.{LB@66}Don't be so stingy.{LB@87}Lend us the money!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus

records.english: {HEX:06}You've never worked an honest day.{LB@37}Yet you expect{LB@52}to be trusted? Too naive!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio

records.english: Please, Julio!{LB@30}This was my idea!{LB@61}Won't you reconsider?{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor

records.english: {HEX:06}Hmm. That's a fortune.{LB@25}Even with FI asking...{LB@48}What does your father say{LB@75}about it?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio

records.english: No help from father this time.{LB@30}The money will be repaid.{LB@57}Please, Julio!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor

records.english: {HEX:06}Standing alone?{LB@19}Good, good. Still...{LB@44}Your resolve is firm{LB@65}but...{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio

records.english: My father still treats me{LB@28}like a child.{LB@49}He would never approve.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor

records.english: Something has to change{LB@24}right here, right now!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor

records.english: {HEX:05}That's the spirit!{LB@23}A man needs courage!{LB@45}Never back down!{LB@65}FI!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus

records.english: {HEX:04}Courage is fine,{LB@19}but without money{LB@48}we go nowhere...{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus

records.english: {HEX:05}Don't say that...{LB@27}Ah...{LB@34}Must we earn it slowly?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus

records.english: {HEX:06}Now that you have it,{LB@25}repay it with interest.{LB@49}Understood?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio
